benefits.name: Annual Travel Credit
benefits.description: General-purpose statement credit toward travel purchases.
benefits.terms: Applies automatically to travel purchases. No enrollment required.

benefits.name: The Edit by Chase Travel Hotel Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for prepaid bookings of 2+ nights at The Edit hotel properties through Chase Travel.
benefits.terms: Up to $250 per booking, $500/year total. Requires a minimum 2-night stay.

benefits.name: Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables Dining Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for dining at Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables restaurants, split across two half-year periods.
benefits.terms: $150 Jan-June, $150 July-Dec ($300/year total). No enrollment required.

benefits.name: StubHub / Viagogo Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for purchases on StubHub or Viagogo, split across two half-year periods.
benefits.terms: $150 Jan-June, $150 July-Dec ($300/year total). Promotional benefit through Dec. 31, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Select Hotels Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for prepaid stays of 2+ nights at select partner hotel brands (IHG, Montage, Pendry, Omni, Virgin, Minor, Pan Pacific) booked through Chase Travel.
benefits.terms: Requires minimum 2-night prepaid stay. Promotional benefit through Dec. 31, 2026 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: TSA PreCheck / Global Entry / NEXUS Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a TSA PreCheck, Global Entry, or NEXUS application fee.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership + DoorDash Credits
benefits.description: One year of complimentary DashPass membership plus monthly DoorDash promo credits.
benefits.terms: Requires activation. DashPass membership must be activated by Dec. 31, 2027 per current promotion. Monthly DoorDash credits ($5 restaurant + two $10 non-restaurant promos = $25/month, $300/year) run through the same period; confirm these dates are still current before relying on them.

benefits.name: Lyft Ride Credit
benefits.description: Monthly Lyft ride credit, in addition to the 5x total points earning rate on Lyft.
benefits.terms: Requires linking the card in the Lyft app. Promotional benefit through Sep. 30, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Peloton Membership Credit
benefits.description: Monthly statement credit toward a qualifying Peloton membership.
benefits.terms: Requires activation at onepeloton.com. Promotional benefit through Dec. 31, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it. Separate from the 10x points earned on Peloton equipment purchases.

benefits.name: Apple TV + Apple Music Subscription
benefits.description: Complimentary subscription to Apple TV and Apple Music.
benefits.terms: Requires one-time activation by Jun. 22, 2027 per current promotion; confirm this deadline is still current before relying on it. Provides 12+ months of complimentary access from activation.

benefits.name: 5x Total Points on Lyft
benefits.description: Earn 5x total points on Lyft rides, bikes, scooters, and subscriptions purchased through the Lyft app.
benefits.terms: Promotional rate through Sep. 30, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it. Excludes fees, taxes, tips, and gift card purchases.

benefits.name: 10x Points on Peloton Equipment
benefits.description: Earn 10x points on eligible Peloton equipment and accessory purchases over $150, capped at 50,000 bonus points.
benefits.terms: Minimum purchase $150. Capped at 50,000 total bonus points. Promotional rate through Dec. 31, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Sapphire Lounge, Priority Pass, and Maple Leaf Lounge Access
benefits.description: Complimentary access to Chase Sapphire Lounges, Priority Pass Select lounges, and select Air Canada Maple Leaf Lounges/Cafés.

networks: Chase Sapphire Lounge by The Club
loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Up to two complimentary guests at Chase Sapphire Lounges and Priority Pass lounges; $27 per additional Priority Pass guest.

benefits.terms: Priority Pass requires separate enrollment through Chase. Maple Leaf Lounge access requires an eligible boarding pass in the U.S., Canada, or Europe.

benefits.name: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status.
benefits.terms: Requires linking an IHG One Rewards account. Promotional benefit through Dec. 31, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Primary coverage for damage/theft on most rental cars, up to $75,000.
benefits.terms: Primary coverage (not secondary). Decline the rental company's collision coverage to activate. Rentals under 31 consecutive days only.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $10,000 per covered traveler and $20,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $500 per covered traveler for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed 6+ hours.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 5 days for essential purchases when checked luggage is delayed 6+ hours.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $10,000 per item.

benefits.name: Return Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $500 per item ($1,000 per 12-month period) when an eligible item can't be returned to the merchant within 90 days.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less by an additional year.

benefits.name: Emergency Evacuation and Transportation Coverage
benefits.description: Up to $100,000 for emergency evacuation when injury or illness occurs 100+ miles from home.

benefits.name: Roadside Dispatch
benefits.description: Discounted roadside assistance (tow, battery, tire change, locksmith, fuel delivery), up to $50 per incident, up to 4 times per year.
benefits.terms: Up to $50 per incident, up to 4 incidents/year.

earningRates.terms: All purchases through Chase Travel, including The Edit.
Flights and hotels booked directly with the airline/hotel, outside Chase Travel.
